newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania says not to privatise media companies.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania says not to privatise media companies.

text.p: Tanzania's information minister says state-owned media companies will not be privatised.

Kingunge Ngombale-Mwiru, minister of state for information, said the government would not sell its holdings in Tanzania Standard Newspapers, publishers of the English-language Daily News and the Sundays News.
On a tour of the Daily News on Thursday, Ngombale-Mwiru said the state would also maintain its news agency, Shihata.
"The government has a role to educate the people, a role that cannot be fully left for the private media," the Daily News quoted Ngombale-Mwiru as saying in its Friday edition.

An official of the Parastatal Sector Reform Commission (PSRC) told Reuters on Monday that 31 government companies would be sold by the end of this month, with the total rising to 78 by the end of the year. The official said a total of 128 companies would be sold by the end of next year.
